verdict.rationale: Letta has automations in the form of scheduled tasks. Agent memory lives in a Git-backed memory repository: `/remember` updates are committed to MemFS and shared memory is a Git repo. That implies some versioning of agent state, and `/fork` lets you branch a conversation without changing the original. Missing for 10: versioning of scheduled tasks, mods, or skills; a documented review/diff workflow for automation changes; a documented rollback or restore of a prior automation or memory version; independent or hands-on corroboration.
